Blocking flaw — the progress reward is not dense: only the very first kill is ever paid, via (u0, !top_breach & zombie_killed, u1) -> 1; in u1 a zombie_killed step matches only the else self-loop and scores 0, so in a typical episode with ~20 kills the shaping signal dies after a single event. Either reward every kill in the safe states or drop the kill bonus entirely and collapse to the two-state pure-safety machine; a single first-kill bonus is the inconsistent middle. Minor notes: the !top_breach conjunct in the u0 kill transition is redundant under first-match ordering (harmless), and on a step where top_breach and zombie_killed co-occur the kill reward is forfeited to the breach branch — an acceptable priority, though with per-kill rewards you may prefer to still credit the kill. As submitted, the candidate fails the density requirement and is non-compact, so it is not accepted.
